sourceKind: native sprite compositions using the approved whole-character plant rig

plant.scope: Accepted painted Chill-shroom and shared rig retained. A Cold Front win, including an existing valid win, unlocks the native addon packet for normal seed selection and saved decks.
plant.almanac: Native compact catalog packet, formatted statistics, brown italic character biography and animated portrait; unlocks after Cold Front including an existing valid win.

cards.name: Cone Zone
cards.gameplay: Native bowling conveyor, ten waves and one flag; cone-armored native variants and normal, explosive and giant Wall-nuts. Giant physics are unchanged from native Bowling 2.

cards.name: Night Shift
cards.gameplay: Native nighttime graveyard-control conveyor. Four initial graves, safe empty-tile growth capped at six, warned rises before waves 4/7/10 of at most three normal zombies, guaranteed Grave Busters and a wider mushroom mix. Ten waves and one flag. All eligible mature graves receive the native warning before a capped rise.

cards.name: Cold Front
cards.gameplay: Native preparation and defense puzzle: 1500 sun, no graves or income, four waves; the original Lets Rock button starts combat.

cards.name: Garden Shuffle
cards.gameplay: Fixed garden of three Repeaters, a Snow Pea and two Wall-nuts. Move existing living plants with the native glove; health and attack state persist. Ten rotating-lane waves, forty authored zombies, one-second move cooldown and no sun or seed economy.

cards.name: Seed Swap
cards.hero: REANIM_WALLNUT with original Repeater seed packet
cards.gameplay: Fixed garden of two Peashooters and one Wall-nut per lane. Zombie kills drop native seed packets. Plant only by replacing a living plant; no sun economy, seed bank or shovel. Ten waves change the enemy mix.

cards.name: Intensive Lawn Care
cards.hero: Approved Mender-bloom DrawRig with original Flower Pot and IMAGE_ZEN_GARDENGLOVE
cards.gameplay: Conveyor patients start wounded. Move the same living combat plants between a protected Flower Pot healing bed beside fixed Mender-blooms and the front lines with the native glove. Active combat tires deployed plants; bed patients recover with normal Mender healing and cannot fire. Ten authored waves, five starting Repeaters and Wall-nuts, one-second move cooldown and no sun economy.

cards.name: Chain Reaction
cards.hero: Original REANIM_CHERRYBOMB and REANIM_JALAPENO idle sprites with armed REANIM_POTATOMINE
cards.gameplay: Five hand-arranged explosive puzzles. Place a finite supply of Cherry Bombs, Jalapenos and Potato Mines, then use the native Let's Rock button. Native blasts and walking zombies resolve each arrangement; one trophy follows the fifth board.

cards.name: Rally Point
cards.hero: Original REANIM_ZOMBIE body and articulated original arm tracks, with native-coded shaded megaphone
cards.gameplay: Ten authored day-lawn waves built around Rally Zombie groups. A fixed six-plant bank and seven starting plants provide immediate counterplay; native sun, planting, recharge, mowers, armor and victory rules remain active. Calls briefly raise eligible nearby walkers to 1.45 times their base speed, do not stack and stop when their source is frozen, buttered, eating, headless or armless.
cards.artwork: The unmodified native head, body, legs and arm images supply the character. The original reaching arm pose is blended into each walking pose to raise and lower a shaded ivory megaphone with a brick-red rim. The 80 by 65 card is rendered from this actual rig, fitted to the existing centered portrait bounds.
cards.almanac: One additional native zombie window in the unused bottom-left space; original zombie positions and Dr. Zomboss are retained. The portrait animates using the same rig and call clock, with native formatted statistics and brown italic character biography.

cards.name: Rally Raid
cards.hero: Original repaired Rally Zombie rig and IMAGE_BRAIN, composed at native card resolution
cards.gameplay: Five fixed I, Zombie boards. Spend a finite sun budget to deploy normal, conehead, buckethead, screen-door and Rally Zombies on the right-hand lawn. Eat all five native brains on each board; Chill-shroom and Mender-bloom join the authored cardboard defenses. Only board five grants the completion award.
cards.artwork: The existing original zombie rig and repaired closed grip accompany an original brain sprite rendered at final card resolution, fitted up to 22 by 20 pixels. The combined composition fits the centered 68 by 57 hero bounds inside the native 80 by 65 card. No separately generated illustration is used.
cards.interface: Original I, Zombie bank, brains, deployment line, native pause/Menu/speed controls and brain meter. Native footer shows board progress. Raid uses the original I, Zombie draw order and packet-feedback layers; top-row zombie heads render in front of the bank exactly as in that mode.

cards.name: Lights Out
cards.hero: Original REANIM_PLANTERN idle rig, centered over original nighttime lawn with original fog cels
cards.gameplay: Move one living Plantern between five rail cells with the native glove. Fixed defenders attack only inside its two-tile Manhattan light footprint. A short opening introduces the light before authored waves require lane changes; original combat, mowers, pause, speed and completion rules remain active.
cards.artwork: The complete original Plantern body, eyes, stem and leaves are rendered from its unmodified native rig. Two original software-fog cels sit behind its silhouette. The composition uses the same centered 68 by 57 hero bounds inside the existing 80 by 65 card; no separately generated illustration is used.
cards.interface: Name-only tenth Bonus card in the native fifth column of row two. The original glove uses one bounded draw and hit rectangle, and the normal Menu/speed controls and footer remain clear.

cards.name: Garlic Run
cards.hero: Original REANIM_GARLIC idle rig with original REANIM_SPIKEWEED and armed REANIM_POTATOMINE
cards.gameplay: Five short native routing puzzles. Reposition living Garlic with the original glove to steer native zombies through fixed Spikeweed and Potato Mine traps; original plant artwork, attacks, health and garlic diversion remain active.
cards.artwork: The complete original Garlic is the centered hero above a small route made from original Spikeweed and armed Potato Mine rigs. The composition fits the same centered 68 by 57 hero bounds inside the native 80 by 65 card; no separately generated illustration is used.
cards.interface: Name-only eleventh Bonus card in the first column of row three. Native glove, preparation Start button, Menu/speed controls and board footer use the existing game style.

cards.name: Bungee Business
cards.hero: Original REANIM_BUNGEE raising rig carrying the original REANIM_SUNFLOWER, with original REANIM_UMBRELLALEAF support
cards.gameplay: Five native heist puzzles. Spend a limited zombie budget to clear Umbrella-leaf coverage, then steal the Sunflowers with actual Bungee Zombies and original native abduction mechanics.
cards.artwork: The original Bungee raising pose and carried Sunflower use the native body/plant offset and forearm occlusion order. An original Umbrella-leaf supports the composition; its complete visible bounds are centered and fitted to the same 68 by 57 hero area inside the native 80 by 65 card. No separately generated illustration is used.
cards.interface: Name-only twelfth Bonus card in the second column of row three. The original I, Zombie bank, sun budget, Menu/speed controls and native footer retain the existing game style.

cards.name: Cob Cannon Command
cards.hero: Original REANIM_COBCANNON loaded idle rig; the complete two-square cannon is uniformly fitted and centered
cards.gameplay: A continuous artillery battle against moving native zombie formations. Preplaced Cob Cannons keep their original initial arming, two-click aiming, projectile flight, blast and reload mechanics.
cards.artwork: The complete original loaded Cob Cannon assembly is rendered at native resolution, then fitted once within68 by57 pixels at the center of the80 by65 native Bonus picture. No redrawn parts, generated image or reused Survival picture.
cards.interface: Original Cob Cannon target reticle, Menu, speed and pause controls, native wave progress and footer. No plant chooser, persistent challenge tips or additional HUD.

historicalArt: Chill.4 assembled-part proportions were rejected. The approved Chill.5 whole-character geometry is retained byte-for-byte in all alpha masks; Chill.6 refines surface painting only. Cards still compose actual game sprites; no standalone generated challenge illustration is used.

animation.mechanics: Release-time radial slow, no damage or delayed projectile hit; native puffs are the visual plume.

checkpointCompatibility: State-zero existing bonus checkpoints keep their previous fixed-bank twenty-wave rules. Chill.8 arcade checkpoints retain saved boards/belts/waves and gain new mechanics on later events; New Game starts the revised opening/roster. Existing completion rewards remain valid. Garden Shuffle uses new mode76 and unused profile record75 with unchanged native object layouts; moves preserve the original plant instance. Seed Swap appends mode77 and unused profile record76; native Coin, Cursor, Plant and Challenge serialized members retain packet drops and replacement gardens. Intensive Lawn Care appends mode78 and unused profile record77; native cursor, plant, conveyor and challenge fields preserve wounded crew, moves, fatigue, supply and recovery without serialized layout changes. Rally Point appends mode80 and unused profile record79; Rally Zombie appends type33. Existing Board, Challenge, Zombie and profile saved layouts are unchanged; its existing native summon counter preserves the call cadence. Rally Raid appends mode81 and uses reserved profile record80. Packet77 remains outside original plant/cache/chooser ranges. Existing serialized challenge stage, state, timer, sun, actors and brain counters preserve each of five boards without new saved fields.

supportPlant.almanac: Native compact catalog packet, formatted statistics, brown italic character biography and animated portrait; unlocks after Seed Swap including an existing valid win.
supportPlant.gameplay: 125 sun, 15-second recharge; heals each eligible living persistent plant in the eight adjacent squares by 10 HP every three simulation seconds, capped at maximum health. No self healing or damage.
supportPlant.artwork: Distinct coral cupped-blossom head with a face on the front petal, generated using original-game style references. Original native stem and leaves remain byte-identical; the shared idle, blink and healing rig is retained.

chooserPresentation.customPackets: Inside the left panel footer; original plants, buttons and Imitater keep their native layout.
